Unidentified object · Recovery · Poland

Possible drone wreckage found on Karwia beach, Poland

13 October 2026 · Karwia beach · possible drone wreckage

Provisional possible-drone wreckage; foreign involvement unsubstantiated

A civilian found an object resembling a drone partly buried in sand on Karwia beach in Puck County on 13 October 2026. The discovery was reported around 18:20–18:30. The object was said to be about two metres long; its exact identification remains pending.

Police secured the area and Military Gendarmerie personnel and prosecutors began investigating. RMF reported preliminary indications that it might belong to the Polish military. That is not an official identification, and no foreign involvement or border crossing has been established.

No casualties, damage or controlled detonation were reported in the supplied update. This is a provisional wreckage-discovery record for identification follow-up. The discovery date does not establish when the object flew or fell.
